day.headline: A Ox day — Snake and Rooster are in step.

reasons: Snake and Ox share a triad — strong alignment today
signs.message: Everyone's got a take on it. Say yours first, loudly.

reasons: Rat pairs with Ox — a harmonious day
signs.message: That crusted skillet takes four minutes. Do it before you sit.

reasons: Dog sits apart from Ox — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Forty-second voice note, still gray. Play it walking to pilates.

reasons: Rooster and Ox share a triad — strong alignment today
signs.message: Retake the awful little photo today. You look nothing like that.

reasons: Goat opposes Ox — a day to take slowly
signs.motif: the newsletter you never unsubscribe from
signs.message: You skim it every week. Unsubscribe, takes one tap.

reasons: Pig sits apart from Ox — the day is yours to steer

signs.message: Fourth attempt at one sentence. Leave it, come back tomorrow.
